messages:
ops-bot: P2 alert — sustained queue growth on emerald-13b family (>95th perc latency climbing). Auto-scaling not catching up. Investigating.

Sam (oncall): seeing a ton of queued TTLs and worker GC spikes. Clients starting to see 429s. Any recent deploys?

deploy-bot: No deploys in last 30m to emerald-*; last deploy 1987653000 by rachel.

Anya: confirmed elevated TPM from a single customer running long streaming sessions. Top source: acct:acme-inc, route:/v1/chat/stream.

Mike: can we throttle per-route or per-customer quickly? We should avoid a full family carveout.

Sam (oncall): plan proposal: 1) reduce TPM for emerald-13b from 1200 -> 600 for non-enterprise tier 2) preserve enterprise and canary 3) enable prefix KV caching for hot routes 4) if no improvement in 10m, disable streaming for emerald-13b. Thoughts?

Rachel: +1 on surgical TPM carve. Need exact commands, I'll execute. Also will DM account team re: acme-inc.

Kevin: I can push a temporary routing rule: route priority lower for free-tier -> will move some traffic to emerald-7b fallback. That buy us headroom.

Anya: Customer impact: ~0.8% of overall QPS but responsible for 40% of emerald-13b TPM peak. If we throttle, some backpressure will shift to other models.

Sam (oncall): okay doing two changes now: 1) apply per-model per-tier TPM change 2) add temporary rate-limit header for the acct. Rachel will run the internal CLI.

Rachel: running: 
```
# lower TPM for emerald-13b free tier
scli quota update --model emerald-13b --tier free --tpm 600 --rpm 18000 --reason "live mitigation - queue growth"
# add customer-specific throttling
scli quota update --customer acme-inc --model emerald-13b --tpm 200 --rpm 6000 --reason "excessive streaming"
```

Rachel: applied. API returned 200. Changes propagated to control plane.

Mike: I enabled routing fallback for free-tier emerald-13b -> emerald-7b for non-streaming routes. Config snippet: 
```
routing.set_policy("emerald-13b", fallback=[{"model":"emerald-7b","weight":0.35}])
```

Sam (oncall): monitoring. Graphs show queue depth falling within 90s. Latency 95th dropping. 429s for clients decreased ~70%.

Anya: We still see a small bump in tail for streaming sessions. Could temporarily disable streaming handlers for emerald-13b if it resurges.

Kevin: Noted customer comms: AM to acme-inc sent, asked to reduce long-running sessions. ops@cc'd.

Sam (oncall): runbook check: mark incident mitigated if no regression in 15m. We should record exact deltas: TPM free tier 1200->600, acct throttle 200 TPM, routing fallback 35% to emerald-7b.

Rachel: adding audit log entry: 
```
PATCH /internal/quotas
{
  "actor": "rachel",
  "reason": "live mitigation - emerald-13b queue growth",
  "changes": ["free-tier tpm 1200->600","acme-inc tpm 200","fallback 35% -> emerald-7b"]
}
```

Mike: also adding a temporary alert suppression for noisy queuing on emerald-13b to avoid paging on every small blip. Will reopen if 95th > 1.8s for 3 consecutive minutes.

Anya: follow-up action items: 1) growth team to rate-limit streaming per-customer (tracking) 2) infra to tune autoscaler thresholds for emerald family 3) product to consider lighter quantization variant for fallback.

Sam (oncall): handoff to Kevin for the next hour to watch for regressions. If everything stable at last check mark mitigated and close thread.

Kevin: taking handoff. Will post a status update in 15m. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Event logged: mitigation/1987654321, actions=[quota_change, routing_fallback, customer_throttle], severity=P2, owner=Kevin.

Kevin: 15m check — metrics steady, queue depth normal, tail latency back to baseline. No new 429 spikes. Closing mitigation but leaving quotas in place for 2h.

Sam (oncall): thanks team. Postmortem will capture root cause (acme-inc streaming pattern) and permanent guardrails.

Rachel: leaving one note: if we need to roll back quotas, command is scli quota update --model emerald-13b --tier free --tpm 1200 --rpm 36000

Kevin: closing thread — marked mitigated.
